Of The Code Of The Cr.P.C. 1973.
 This Petition, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

This petition is filed by accused Nos.1 to 4 under Section 482 of the Cr.PC for quashing the FIR in Crime No.15/2023 registered by the Banashankari Police Station for the offence punishable under Sections 417, 406, 420 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
During the pendency of the petition both petitioners and respondent No.2 appeared through their counsel and filed joint compromise petition under Section 320 read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C.
The matter has been settled between the parties.
The dispute arises out of the contractual obligation between the parties.
As a compromise, the petitioner has handed over a demand draft bearing No.003519 dated 18.04.2023 for a sum of Rs.40,00,000/- to respondent No.2.

The same is issued and acknowledged by the respondent No.2.
3.
The learned counsel places on record that the main offence is of 420 of the IPC, which is compoundable.
Hence, the application is allowed and permitted them to compound the offence.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
The FIR against the petitioners is quashed.
